title: 3D Character Builder
caption: Build your hero with sliders and pickers, dress them in a click, and save a rigged 3D model that walks, runs and fights.

title: Dozens of species
caption: Humans, dwarves, elves, orcs, two-headed dragonkin, catfolk, tieflings and starship crews, all from one builder.

title: Creatures
caption: Add dragons, wolves, horses, sharks, birds and insects to your world, each saved as a rigged 3D model.

title: 3D Prop Builder
caption: Make vehicles, furniture, sci-fi consoles, weapons and treasure chests, then drop them straight onto your maps.

title: Windows of their own
caption: Keep the Database and the event editor open beside your map, or move them to a second monitor.

title: Climb, grapple and jump
caption: Send units up onto roofs and see the fall damage before they jump back down.

title: Effects in battles on the map
caption: Effekseer skill effects burst right on the map in Tactical battles, with the camera moving in on the action.

title: The world in 3D
caption: Walk a lamplit village at night, with maps that join with no stall at the border.
